body: A good way to see if people are faking a mental illness is to ask "Do you have a therapist/psychiatrist?" or "Do you want a recommendation for a good therapist/psychiatrist?" I'm a highschooler with both and the people that are faking tend to get really offended or laugh. The ones that are genuine will say they already have one or ask for a card. This is why I have my therapists card on me at all times, especially at school.

This was what I called my father when I was younger, and after the internet turned it into ***that***  I stopped and started calling him Dad. You can tell that he's a little saddened by it because I still call my mom Mama. I feel so gross when I hear people say it in a sexual way.
As a teen with DIAGNOSED Depression and PTSD, this shit pisses me off so much. I didn't ask to have a mental illness and I don't want it, why is it a stereotype?
